items.name: brand-visual-asset-generator
items.title: Brand Visual Asset Generator
items.description: Generate brand-aligned SVG asset packs for SaaS products using Context.dev brand extraction and a Quiver Arrow SVG tool.

items.name: branded-seo-page-builder
items.title: Branded SEO Page Builder
items.description: Generate an on-brand, SEO-optimized HTML page from a domain using Context.dev brand, content, and styleguide data.

items.name: code-reviewer
items.title: Code Reviewer
items.description: Eve agent for GitHub PR review. Mention it on a PR for inline comments on bugs, not style.

items.name: competitor-intel-monitor
items.title: Competitor Intel Monitor
items.description: Scheduled competitor URL monitor that diffs pages and delivers scored Slack or email digests.

items.name: crm-hygiene-agent
items.title: CRM Hygiene Agent
items.description: Scheduled CRM hygiene via Connect that proposes dedupe, normalize, and enrich batches for human approval before any write.

items.name: docs-knowledge-assistant
items.title: Docs Knowledge Assistant
items.description: Answers from your repo docs and cites the file.

items.name: email-triage-assistant
items.title: Email Triage Assistant
items.description: Inbox triage that classifies threads and writes draft replies without sending.

items.name: eve-agent-builder
items.title: Eve Agent Builder
items.description: An Eve coding agent that creates Eve agents, runs their checks, deploys them to Vercel, and verifies the live routes.

items.name: github-ci-explainer
items.title: GitHub CI Explainer
items.description: Explains failed GitHub Actions checks from the log.

items.name: github-issue-maintainer
items.title: GitHub Issue Maintainer
items.description: Labels GitHub issues, asks for missing repro, and emails a weekly digest.

items.name: inbound-lead-qualifier
items.title: Inbound Lead Qualifier
items.description: Inbound lead qualifier via signed intake or Connect CRM/Typeform that scores ICP fit, drafts approved CRM notes, and Slack-notifies hot leads only.

items.name: invoice-chase-drafter
items.title: Invoice Chase Drafter
items.description: Weekday AR chase via Connect that drafts mailbox reminders from QuickBooks or Xero and posts an idempotent Slack digest after a paid re-check.

items.name: knowledge-base-gardener
items.title: Knowledge Base Gardener
items.description: Finds stale product docs and drafts updates with file cites.

items.name: linear-operations-agent
items.title: Linear Operations Agent
items.description: An Eve agent for Linear operations across Linear, Slack, and scheduled runs.

items.name: meeting-action-extractor
items.title: Meeting Action Extractor
items.description: Extracts owners and deadlines from a meeting transcript and drafts Linear follow-ups for approval.

items.name: openui-assistant
items.title: OpenUI Assistant
items.description: An Eve agent that streams OpenUI Lang generative UI using the official openuiChatLibrary, with demo weather, stock, and search tools from the openui-chat example.

items.name: postgres-data-analyst
items.title: Postgres Data Analyst
items.description: An Eve-native Slack analyst for a single Postgres database. It answers Slack mentions and DMs, inspects schema metadata, and runs bounded read-only SQL through authored tools.

items.name: programmatic-seo-agent
items.title: Programmatic SEO Agent
items.description: Weekly scheduled agent that grows a product's organic traffic with programmatic SEO: it checks the product's GitHub repository out into its sandbox, discovers and validates keyword opportunities with DataForSEO, researches each target with the Parallel web search API, generates batches of SEO-optimized pages matching the repo's content conventions, and pushes them as a pull request for human review.

items.name: rfp-response-drafter
items.title: RFP Response Drafter
items.description: RFP response drafter via Google Drive Connect and sandbox files that cites every claim, Slack-routes SME gaps, and write-backs approved Drive or mailbox drafts without portal submit.

items.name: supabase-data-analyst
items.title: Supabase Data Analyst
items.description: A Slack-native Eve analyst for a single Supabase project that only runs read-only SQL queries. It exposes just supabase__list_tables and supabase__execute_sql through an MCP client connection to the hosted Supabase MCP server; no write, migration, Edge Function, branch, storage, logs, advisors, account, or docs tools are available.

items.name: support-reply-draft
items.title: Support Reply Draft
items.description: Drafts a customer reply from product docs and cites the file.

items.name: x-draft-assistant
items.title: X Draft Assistant
items.description: A scheduled Eve agent that scans a configured set of X (Twitter) profiles every day, surfaces hot topics from their recent posts, researches each topic with the [Parallel](https://parallel.ai/) web search API, and creates **three draft candidates** for X in [Typefully](https://typefully.com) so a human can review and publish them.

items.name: x-hot-topic-digest
items.title: X Hot Topic Digest
items.description: A scheduled Eve agent that scans a configured set of X (Twitter) profiles every day, surfaces hot topics from their recent posts, researches each topic with the [Parallel](https://parallel.ai/) web search API, and delivers an HTML digest by email through [Resend](https://resend.com).
